Maya: Heads-up — MedAtlas wants a final perf run next Tue 08:00 PDT. They need a concise runbook + a pricing delta for burst capacity. @Hugo @Priya can you own infra + payloads?

Hugo: On it. My plan: three gates — quick smoke (3m), steady (25m), chaos bursts (3x short ramps). Steady QPS 900 r/s, bursts to 3k r/s for 90s. Which model/seq?

Priya: Product note: de-id clinical extraction, avg prompt 300 tokens, gen ~200. Use model=redwood-medic-70b-8bit. We'll test with max_tokens=200, temp=0.0.

Maya: MedAtlas SLO: p95 < 400ms. Procurement asks for: (A) POC cost estimate, (B) weekly 24/7 baseline pricing, (C) optional burst-addon per-month.

Colin: Runbook (draft):
- pool: 6xA100-80GB (redwood.dedicated.x6)
- workers/node=6, concurrency/worker=10
- batch cap=8ms, batching jitter=2ms
- enable KV cache + persistent caches on disk for repeated templates
- gateway limit 7s

Priya: Test payload set: 25 templates + 10 edge-case probes (longer prompts). Average sequence ~500 tokens. Using wrk with LUA rotation and short HTTP keepalive.

Hugo: CLI for main run:
```
wrk -t12 -c1600 -d00:25:00 --script=med_templates.lua https://staging.redwood/medatlas/v1/generate
```
med_templates.lua includes Authorization and cycles templates.

Colin: Quick vegeta smoke before running full:
```
echo "POST https://staging.redwood/medatlas/v1/generate" | vegeta attack -rate=900 -duration=3m | vegeta report
```

bench-bot: smoke-started 1746123459 - warming 6 nodes

bench-bot: smoke-done 1746123679 - mean 160ms p95 270ms throughput 920 r/s

Maya: good. proceed to steady-state. Watch KV hit and gateway queue.

bench-bot: steady-complete 1746125179 - mean 240ms p95 380ms p99 720ms throughput 902 r/s KV_hit=65%

Priya: KV_hit 65% — lower than we'd like. Increase REDWOOD_KV_PERSIST=1 and bump cache to 72GB. Also pre-warm common prefixes.

Colin: Cost quicks: steady 25m @900r/s -> ~2.7M tokens -> ~5 GPU-hours -> est $420 at reserved rate. Continuous 24/7 baseline ~120 GPU-hours/day -> ~$9.6k/day. Burst addon pricing: recommend $950/month block + per-burst usage. Add one-time POC eng fee $2,500.

Hugo: Burst run next. Auto-scale frontends + lower max_tokens to 160 for burst to improve headroom.

bench-bot: burst-start 1746125999 - ramping to 3k r/s

bench-bot: burst-end 1746126090 - peak 2.98k r/s, mean latency 640ms, p95 1.2s, p99 2.8s. Observed frontend queueing and ~22% upstream backpressure.

Priya: Failure mode: frontend bottleneck and transient retries. Mitigations: add 3 frontend replicas OR impose soft rate-limit at gateway, and enable smaller batches (cap 4ms) + decrease max_tokens.

Maya: For deal talk: steady meets SLO (p95 380ms <= 400ms). Burst shows degradation — we can offer burst SLAs with dedicated burst seats or autoscale credits. Call out recommended mitigations and estimated delta cost.

Colin: Security/Procurement asks — they'll want SOC2 link, KMS diagram, and encryption-in-transit details. Prepare a short appendix.

Maya: Action items: Hugo finalize runbook and autoscale play; Priya attach raw CSVs and tuning notes; Colin prepare cost memo + procurement appendix. I'll assemble and post to the deal thread. Thanks team :rocket:
